printed: Isotopic labelling The symbol for the isotope introduced is placed in square brackets directly attached to the part of the name to which it refers (e.g. sodium ('4C]formate); appropriate arabic numerals and prefixes are added as necessary (e.g. L-[2-C]leucine). For simple molecules, chemical formulae may be used (e.g. 4#CO,). Square brackets should not be used when the isotopic symbol is attached to a word that is not a chemical name (e.g. “!*C-labelled”). Terms such as “'![-labelled albumin” should not be contracted to [3!T]albumin since native albumin does not contain iodine.
